actual_scope: Exact minimum for diag([Z_1],[Z_w]) in F2[UT_3(F_4)] on two dirty roles, plus one bounded constructive pivot testing at most three four-call commutator blocks against the dependent three-role central target diag([Z_1],[Z_w],[Z_{w^2}]).
scope_change_reason: The selected random method was a target-specific relaxation, while this session requires a construction-focused assignment. I used the other constructive method listed on the same card, refining its general nonabelian-model question to a class-two order-64 group with a two-dimensional central commutator subgroup and a fixed two-output target.
bottleneck_link: A shorter exact word would reduce the fully charged local bit-call profile; this formal model has no selected-supplier mapping, so even a saving would remain conditional local evidence.
stop_rule: The exact two-role search stops after the complete radius-three ball. The single pivot stops after all ordered sequences of up to three four-call central commutator blocks are checked; do not infer a bound on arbitrary three-role words or search longer.
evidence: For the two-role target, exact MITM excludes all words through six, the I/I^2 trace lemma excludes seven, and a direct word attains eight. The one bounded pivot enumerates all 178,808 ordered sequences of up to three D_N(Z_1/Z_w) blocks in M3(F2); none reaches the dependent triple, while a 14-call direct word passes full and generic endpoints. Exact state digests and positive/deletion/mutation controls are in CERTIFICATE.json.
